plaatsen.tekst: And ye murmured in your tents, and said, Because the LORD hated us, he hath brought us forth out of the land of Egypt, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy
But murmured in their tents, and hearkened not unto the voice of the LORD.
They also that erred in spirit shall come to understanding, and they that murmured shall learn doctrine.
